title: cloudflare-expression-lint configuration
description: Configuration for the Cloudflare expression linter (.cf-expr-lint.json)

expressionKeys.description: Map of YAML key names to expression type and optional phase hint. Merged with built-in defaults (expression, rewrite_expression, source_url_expression, condition).

type.description: The type of expression this key contains

phaseHint.description: Cloudflare phase to use for field validation (e.g., http_request_firewall_custom)

phaseMappings.description: Map of YAML parent key names to Cloudflare phases. Merged with built-in defaults.

ignoreCodes.description: Diagnostic codes to suppress (e.g., contains-placeholders, builder-incompatible)

accountLevelPaths.description: File path patterns for account-level expressions that must end with `and (cf.zone.plan eq "ENT")`

operatorStyle.description: Operator style to enforce. english: flag C-like operators. clike: flag English operators. off: disable.

maxInListItems.description: Warn when a literal in-list has this many items or more. Suggests using a named list ($list_name).
